cards.answer: Sona is an AP-focused support mage who empowers nearby allies with auras, heals and shields while dealing magic damage. She weaves empowered attacks between spells and can stun enemies with Crescendo.
cards.counterplay: Avoid extended poke trades into her healing, and spread out when she can threaten Crescendo.

cards.answer: Power Chord empowers Sona's next basic attack after repeated basic ability casts, adding magic damage and an effect determined by her last basic ability. Successful Q hits on champions and effective W healing or shielding permanently grant basic ability haste up to a cap; further successes then reduce Crescendo's remaining cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Respect her empowered attack during trades, and avoid giving her free Q hits.

citations.quote: Sona gains a permanent stack of Accelerando each time she hits an enemy champion with Hymn of Valor and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with Aria of Perseverance. If she has max stacks, she instead reduces the cooldown of Crescendo each time.

Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.

facts.claim: Successful Q hits on champions and effective W healing or shielding permanently grant basic ability haste up to a cap; further successes then reduce Crescendo's remaining cooldown.

cards.answer: Hymn of Valor automatically sends magic-damage bolts at nearby visible enemies, prioritizing champions. Its aura gives Sona and tagged allied champions bonus magic damage on their next attack. Using Q last makes Power Chord deal increased magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance during her poke, and respect the follow-up attacks from allies she empowers.

cards.answer: Song of Celerity grants Sona bonus movement speed, and its aura grants movement speed to tagged allied champions. Taking damage can shorten Sona's speed boost. Using E last makes Power Chord slow its target.
cards.counterplay: Be cautious when chasing her sped-up team, and respect her empowered slow when retreating.
